metadata.description: TunnelMaster provides traffic and tunnel operations intelligence through real-time and historical operational data analysis.

hero.title: TunnelMaster
hero.subtitle: Tunnel Operations Intelligence
hero.description: TunnelMaster brings real-time and historical traffic management data into one analytical view, helping tunnel operators, traffic management centres and road authorities understand operational events, traffic control actions and changing conditions over time.
hero.imageAlt: TunnelMaster traffic and tunnel operations dashboard

challenge.title: Understand what happened — and why
challenge.paragraph1: Traffic management environments generate large amounts of operational data, but understanding how signs, traffic conditions and events developed over time can be difficult.
challenge.paragraph2: TunnelMaster brings this information together to support retrospective analysis, operational review and continuous improvement.
challenge.cardTitle: From live situation to historical context
challenge.cardText: Instead of viewing only the current operational state, TunnelMaster makes it possible to review how traffic management actions and conditions changed over time — for example, by examining VMS states before, during and after an incident.

capabilities.title: Operational insight from traffic management data

items.title: Real-time and historical VMS monitoring
items.description: Review current and historical Variable Message Sign states across the selected road or tunnel environment.

items.title: Incident-focused operational analysis
items.description: Analyse operational information around incidents and unusual situations to support retrospective review.

items.title: Operational timelines
items.description: Examine how traffic management actions and system states changed before, during and after selected events.

items.title: Reporting and statistics
items.description: Use historical operational data to support reporting, recurring analysis and longer-term development of traffic management practices.

users.title: Road and tunnel operations
users.description: TunnelMaster is designed for organisations responsible for operating, monitoring and analysing road and tunnel environments.

integration.title: Built around existing transport data
integration.paragraph1: TunnelMaster is designed to work with existing traffic management and transport data sources rather than creating another isolated operational system.
integration.paragraph2: Data can be integrated through APIs and standards-based interfaces, enabling information from different sources to be analysed within a common operational context.

metadata.description: Learn about RoadMinded Systems, a Finnish ITS software company combining transport expertise, modern software engineering and open standards across Europe and Asia-Pacific.

hero.title: Independent Software and Technical Advisory for Intelligent Transport Systems
hero.description: RoadMinded Systems bridges transport domain expertise with modern software engineering and open standards. We support operators, authorities and technology providers in designing, building and improving systems that support safer, more efficient and sustainable transport operations.

who.title: Who we are
who.description: RoadMinded Systems is a software-led company operating at the intersection of Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) and modern digital infrastructure.
bullets: Experience within public authorities, highway operators and traffic management centres
Cloud-native software engineering for transport environments
Open standards and interoperability as core architectural principles
who.closing: We work with operators and technology providers to design resilient, standards-based systems that integrate seamlessly into existing transport ecosystems.

region.title: Focused on Europe and Asia-Pacific
region.paragraph1: RoadMinded Systems is incorporated in Finland and operates actively in Taiwan and the wider Asia-Pacific region.
region.paragraph2: We combine European ITS standards and governance frameworks with practical insight into local deployment environments, enabling cross-border collaboration and resilient system design.

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.name: Ilkka Kotilainen (家安迪) — Founder & CEO
paragraphs: Ilkka Kotilainen is a software engineer and transport systems specialist focused on Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS), transport data engineering and standards-based software design.

His experience spans public authorities, highway operators and industry, working directly with traffic management centres and tunnel operations through system development, pilots, studies and the implementation of interoperable transport software solutions.
His work focuses on practical ITS software, cloud-native architecture, open standards and long-term maintainability, with current activities spanning Europe, Taiwan and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

process.title: How we work
process.description: We take a practical, problem-solving approach to transport and infrastructure software challenges, focusing on clarity, technical soundness and maintainable solutions.

items.title: 1. Understand & clarify
items.description: We analyse your existing systems, data and operational context to define clear technical objectives, constraints and integration requirements.

items.title: 2. Architect & design
items.description: We design system architectures, data models and integration patterns aligned with open standards, interoperability and security principles.

items.title: 3. Develop & iterate
items.description: We develop targeted software solutions or analytical tools to address identified needs, refining them through testing and feedback to ensure reliable integration within existing ITS environments.

principles.title: Principles
principles.description: These principles guide how we design, develop and integrate transport systems.

items.title: Standards-driven
items.description: We prioritise open, well-defined standards to reduce vendor lock-in and ensure interoperability across systems and stakeholders.

items.title: Pragmatic
items.description: We focus on solutions that can be realistically implemented and operated within your technical and organisational context.

items.title: Transparent
items.description: We communicate assumptions, trade-offs and risks clearly, enabling informed technical and strategic decisions.

items.title: Long-term
items.description: We design for lifecycle sustainability, maintainability and future evolution — not only initial deployment.

metadata.description: Privacy information for the RoadMinded Systems website and business enquiries.

hero.title: Privacy Notice
hero.description: This notice explains how RoadMinded Systems processes personal data in connection with this website and general business enquiries.

data.title: 2. Personal data we process
paragraphs: We may process personal data you provide when contacting us, including your name, email address, organisation, role and message content.
Technical information such as IP addresses and request logs may also be processed by services used to operate and secure the website.

purpose.title: 3. Why we process personal data
paragraphs: Personal data may be processed to respond to enquiries, evaluate potential projects and business relationships, communicate with customers and partners, and maintain the security and operation of the website.
Processing is based on our legitimate interests in conducting and developing our business and, where relevant, taking steps prior to entering into a contract.

retention.title: 4. Retention and service providers
paragraphs: Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary for the purposes described above and to meet applicable legal, contractual and accounting requirements.

We may use service providers for website hosting, email, communications and other technical services. Where personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, appropriate safeguards are used as required by applicable data protection law.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and analytics
cookies.description: RoadMinded Systems does not currently use advertising or marketing cookies on this website. If analytics or other technologies that require additional information or consent are introduced later, this notice will be updated accordingly.

rights.title: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on the circumstances, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data, restrict or object to its processing, and request data portability.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.
